== Title ==
<span lang="ja">デス・スター・レベル6中央シャフト通路</span>. The Light Side title has one dot. The Dark Side title has one asterisk.

== Card Text ==
'''Light Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、デス・スター内でルークとオビ＝ワンの戦闘力が＋2される。</span>

'''Dark Side''' — <span lang="ja">ここを支配しているなら、敵側はデス・スターの各位置カードを支配するのに能力値2を必要とする。</span>

== Lore ==
The card has no printed lore box.

== Translation of Japanese Text ==
'''Title''' — Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor.

'''Lore''' — The card has no printed lore box.

'''Game text''' — Light Side. If you control this site, Luke and Obi-Wan are each power +2 within the Death Star. Dark Side. If you control, the opponent needs ability 2 to control each Death Star location card.

The Japanese Light Side text explicitly places the power bonus within the Death Star. The original English face states the power bonus without those words.<ref>[[:File:P2P-L-deathstarlevel6coreshaftcorridor-printed-scan.png|Original English face]], [[Death Star: Level 6 Core Shaft Corridor]].</ref>
